fragrance_concept.smell_signature: This fragrance opens with a burst of cooling mint and zesty citrus, reminiscent of a refreshing iced tea on a hot day. As it dries, it transitions into a warm, tropical fruity blend, evoking the scent of a beachside spa's signature tea-infused massage oil.

note_guide.smells_like: currant bud black currant bud, sulfurous
